kultivator.dampak.setting.skyride.tip: When you cast a Dewa ultimate, the camera climbs the pillar of light, breaks through the sea of clouds into the sky, then rides the strike back down (at most 4 seconds). Only with Cinematic camera Full, only when safe, and skippable with Backspace or any key. First: once per technique per session. Always: every time. Off: no ride.
kultivator.dampak.setting.frames.tip: A brief flash when an ultimate lands. Soft: one faint tint, no colour inversion. Full: three full-screen frames with colour inversion and impact streaks (needs the photosensitivity warning confirmed). Off: no frames. Follows Screen flashes and Hide Lightning Flashes.
kultivator.dampak.setting.silent.tip: An ultimate lands in silence and its boom arrives after a pause; the farther away, the later (like thunder). Hostile mob sounds are never muted.
kultivator.dampak.setting.worldfx.tip: Flying chunks of earth, lifted land, glowing sigils and the giant weapon left standing in the crater. All visual only. Off: particles only.
kultivator.dampak.setting.power.tip: Scales the amount and speed of debris, the width of shock rings and the shake, but never past the performance caps.
kultivator.dampak.warning.title: Photosensitivity warning
kultivator.dampak.warning.body: Full impact frames use full-screen flashes and colour inversion. Do not turn them on if you are sensitive to flashing light.

kultivator.dampak.cmd.frames_none: No frames for %s (Impact frames Off, Screen flashes off, or flashes too close together).

kultivator.dampak.cmd.silent.off: Silent impact off: the boom plays at once.
